insurer: THE NEW INDIA ASSURANCE CO. LTD

room_rent.note: Room rent capped at 1% of Sum Insured per day; overall hospitalisation benefit (room+ICU+nursing) capped at 25% of SI

icu.note: ICU/ICCU capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day; included within overall 25% of SI hospitalisation cap

copayment.note: Company pays 90% of admissible claim amount on all claims; applies to all insured persons regardless of age

sub_limits.display: Many sub-limits: cataract ₹10k, hysterectomy ₹22k, modern treatments 10% SI each, etc.
sub_limits.note: Named surgery sub-limits (e.g. cataract ₹10,000, cholecystectomy ₹16,000, angiography ₹13,000); modern treatments each capped at 10% SI; ARMD 10% SI max ₹15,000; mental illness/genetic/menopause 25% SI; professional fees 25% SI; OT/pharmacy 50% SI

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents

ped_waiting.note: Diabetes mellitus and Hypertension covered from inception on payment of additional premium

specific_disease_waiting.display: 18 months (most); 36 months (joint replacement, ARMD, mental illness, genetic)
specific_disease_waiting.note: 90 days for cardiac conditions; 18 months for cataract, hernia, piles, hydrocele, skin disorders etc.; 36 months for joint replacement, osteoporosis, mental illness, ARMD, genetic diseases

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under standard exclusion Excl18

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% increase per claim-free year; max 30%; reduced at same rate if claim made; option to take premium discount instead

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

pre_hosp.note: Subject to maximum 5% of hospital bill

post_hosp.note: Subject to maximum 10% of hospital bill

day_care.note: Specific listed procedures covered; standard day-care definition applies (less than 24 hrs due to technology advancement)

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation explicitly excluded under specific exclusion 4.4.16

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation expenses of donor covered (excluding cost of organ); combined donor+recipient liability capped at recipient's SI

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, etc.) each capped at 10% of SI per policy period

consumables.note: Consumables/non-medical items listed in Annexure I List-I are explicitly excluded; gloves, masks etc. not payable

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly states all treatment must be taken within India (clause 5.14); overseas treatment excluded (4.4.28)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies to original SI; enhanced SI has fresh 60-month period

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes; no coverage during grace period

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual policies with term of 1 year or more; not on renewals or porting

portability.note: Portability and migration both available as per IRDAI guidelines

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary hospitalisation, treatment outside India, Alzheimer's/dementia, venereal disease, CPAP/CPAP instruments, RFQMR/ECP/EECP/hyperbaric oxygen

optional_riders.display: Diabetes & Hypertension cover from inception (additional premium); premium discount in lieu of cumulative bonus
